name: docs-standards
description: Fabrizio's documentation conventions for a repo's docs/ tree — the Diátaxis split (decisions/plans/runbooks/reference), Nygard ADRs, the ephemeral-plan lifecycle, README-index and staleness discipline, the agent and verify callouts, and a session-end doc-maintenance checklist hook. Builds on markdown-standards for the underlying Markdown authoring conventions, and on writing-styles for the instructional-writing style a reference doc is written in.
